results.title: Promise Street, 1988
results.overview: While working on the unfinished self-portrait of her bedridden mother, a young woman notices an unknown presence in her house.

results.title: Yeah Yeah Yeahs: Hidden in Pieces
results.original_title: Yeah Yeah Yeahs: Hidden in Pieces
results.overview: Indie-rock group the Yeah Yeah Yeahs channel the spirit of David Lynch with this exquisitely ethereal, sublimely surreal record of a Los Angeles concert performance.

results.title: The Ambersons
results.overview: In 1960s suburbia, Barney Amberson finds meaning through the ordinary rituals of family life with the department store mannequins he calls his own.

results.title: Cameron Esposito: Nine Months
results.overview: In an impromptu stand-up special recorded 48 hours before giving birth, comedian Cameron Esposito elaborates on life as a nonbinary pregnant person, the shady intricacies of donor screenings, and the bizarre reactions they've experienced from strangers.

results.title: Atcha Atcha
results.overview: This is the last year of master’s degree at the prestigious dance school "Ecole des Sables", founded in Senegal and directed by choreographer and dancer Germaine Acogny, 80 years old. Germaine Acogny received a Golden Lion for her entire career at the 2021 Venice Biennale. Its students from all over Africa give themselves "body and soul" to obtain their diploma, but also the blessing of "the mother of modern African dance" or "mother germaine".

results.title: Twenty One Pilots: Electric Castle 2026
results.overview: Twenty One Pilots taking over Electric Castle’s Main Stage with an unforgettable show, bringing thousands of fans together for one of EC12’s biggest moments.

results.title: Pagsensyas
results.overview: Narding, a boy denied schooling, discovers his voice through an unlikely bond with Maya, a deaf child—where silence becomes a language of learning and hope.

results.title: I Have A Name
results.overview: Inspired by true events, a couple's decision to foster a child draws them into the heartbreaking realities of abuse, trauma, and separation, exposing the challenges of a broken system while offering hope through compassion and love.

results.title: Draniki
results.overview: Max, an ordinary schoolboy with somewhat unusual parents, finds himself in a village for winter break, against his will. In the village, he encounters a dish that's familiar to the locals but new to him - potato pancakes. The boys, along with their cousin, decide to start a business: they convert an old UAZ into a food truck and sell potato pancakes. But how can you tackle adult problems when you're still a child yourself?

results.title: Memoria
results.overview: Memoria follows the story of Richard Howlett, an older man who lives in his secluded forest, separated from the rest of the bustling world. His lonely home is filled with the sounds of nature, the strong river currents, the leaves rustling in the wind, the birds singing in the morning, but the home has a vast emptiness despite the loud ambience. We see Richard reminisce on his old home, the way things were, how they used to be, as he takes his first steps in learning how to remember and respect the past, while learning how to embrace the future.

results.title: Delirium
results.overview: Jude, tormented by a relentless dream, has each night stolen by fear everyday consumed by exhaustion. His avoidance then search for understanding descends him into madness.

results.title: Dog with a Movie Camera
results.overview: A group of middle-aged men dressed as the Nazi high command gather in London to attempt a crucial experiment: making the first film entirely shot by a dog.

results.title: The Kooks @ Columbia Theater, Berlin
results.overview: Every year ARTE organises a concert during the Berlin Film Festival. This year British indie band The kooks are invited to perform at the Columbia Theater, a converted cinema. They play old favourites and tracks from the seventh studio album, Never/Know.

results.title: Dolly: An NBC News Special
results.overview: A look back at Dolly Parton's remarkable journey to stardom, her groundbreaking career and her lasting impact far beyond music.

results.title: Chappell Roan: Lollapalooza Argentina 2026
results.overview: The queen shined as the headliner on Saturday night with a mega iconic show. Between glitter, aesthetics and hits like Good Luck, Babe!, she created a party full of freedom and attitude.

results.title: Blog
results.overview: Fedya is a failed business psychologist. During one of his training sessions, while intoxicated, he makes a scene and becomes a laughing stock in the eyes of those around him. In his blog, Fedya broadcasts the "secrets of success," but he himself has long lost control of his life. His daughter Sonya is a withdrawn, problematic teenager. After her mother's death, an insurmountable wall grew between her and her father, and her grandfather took upon himself the girl's upbringing. After a fight with her peers, Sonya risks ending up in a penal colony - to avoid punishment, she is sent to a summer correctional program at a provincial school. Fedya goes with his daughter: to look after her and at the same time work as a school psychologist until the information noise around his name dies down. There is one summer ahead that can change everything.

results.title: LOVE
results.overview: A gorgeous and frequently emotional rumination on the “big things” in life, James Gallagher’s new short film, Love, poses questions on what we love, why we love it, and what happens when the desire to win becomes detrimental to our experience of ourselves and other people. While that description seems preachy, the film is not didactic—on the contrary, its plot is extremely loose and impressionistic, requiring the viewer some effort to construct its fast-moving snippets into a coherent narrative.

results.title: March On
results.overview: A British Falklands Conflict veteran struggles to reintegrate into civilian life as a “welcome home” party exposes the hidden costs of war, forcing him and his wife to confront the trauma that continues to remain
